Consensus lowest common ancestor of the best BLAST hits

Source: R/blast_lca.R
blast_lca.Rd

For each sequence, the taxon shared by the hits tied with the best one (at_best, see parallel_blast()): the deepest node of the NCBI taxonomy that contains at least consensus of them. With consensus = 1 it is the strict lowest common ancestor; below 1, a few mislabelled references among many tied hits (e.g. one "Picramnia" among 44 Picea) do not push the identification up to a high rank.

The lineages come from get_tax() (lineage_taxids), so the ancestor is exact even with homonyms and clades without rank. Hits without a known taxid (0, empty, not in the taxonomy) do not vote, nor do the hits flagged as not informative (see uninformative_references()). A hit with several taxids votes with the first one.

The default 0.9 was chosen on sequences of known taxonomy (see dev/benchmark/R/10_rank_calibration.R): compared with the strict ancestor it resolved 3 points more genera with almost no more errors, while also accepting one dissenting hit among few ("N - 1") resolved more but about half of the extra ones wrong. With up to 9 tied hits, 0.9 is the strict ancestor.

Usage

blast_lca(
  x,
  consensus = 0.9,
  named_first = TRUE,
  taxonomy = NULL,
  taxonomy_db = NULL,
  taxdump = NULL
)

Arguments

x

BLASTr results: long, as returned by parallel_blast(), or wide (converted with as_blast_long()).

consensus

Fraction of the tied hits (with known taxid) that the ancestor must contain, above 0.5. Defaults to 0.9.

named_first

If TRUE (default), the tied hits named only above genus (e.g. "Bacterium", "alpha proteobacterium XYZ", "Entolomataceae sp.") do not vote when a named species is tied with them: their lineage is right but shallow, and would pull the ancestor up. Hits in open nomenclature within a genus ("Picea sp.", "Carex cf. flava") still vote: they are other species of that genus (or of another one), and keep the ancestor at the genus (or above) instead of on the named species. They count in N tied; LCA support is among the voters.

taxonomy

The table of get_tax() for the taxids of x. NULL (default) calls get_tax(x, taxonomy_db, taxdump = taxdump). Its rank columns define the ranks of LCA ranked ...: keep only some (e.g. species, genus, family, order) to place the ranked ancestor on them.

taxonomy_db, taxdump

Passed to get_tax().

Value

A tibble with one row per sequence: Sequence, LCA taxid, LCA name, LCA rank ("genus", "family", ...; NA for a node without one of the ranks of get_tax(), e.g. a clade or a superfamily), LCA ranked taxid, LCA ranked name, LCA ranked rank (the ancestor itself when it has one of those ranks, otherwise the deepest node above it that has one; a species in open nomenclature, e.g. "Picea sp. X", goes to its genus: for tables by rank), LCA support (fraction of the tied hits it contains), N tied (hits at best) and N tied no taxid. NA for sequences without hits. Join get_tax(result$LCA taxid) for its ranks and lineage.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- parallel_blast(seqs, db_path)
lca <- blast_lca(res)
dplyr::left_join(lca, get_tax(lca$`LCA taxid`), by = c(`LCA taxid` = "taxid"))
} # }
